title: Legal Notice (general, with statutory variants)
description: Formal demand-and-deadline notice preceding legal action. Statutory provision numbers are fields to fill from sources, never pre-filled.

required_fields.name: sender_name_address
required_fields.description: Full name, description and address of the person on whose behalf the notice is sent.

required_fields.name: recipient_name_address
required_fields.description: Full name and address of the addressee.

required_fields.name: subject
required_fields.description: One-line subject (e.g. demand towards unpaid invoice).

required_fields.name: facts_chronology
required_fields.description: Clear chronological account of events, free of exaggeration.

required_fields.name: legal_grounds
required_fields.description: Legal basis with the statutory provision cited. Fill the provision from sources.

required_fields.name: demand_relief
required_fields.description: Exactly what the recipient must do (pay a sum, vacate, replace, cease).

required_fields.name: compliance_days
required_fields.description: Reasonable compliance period in days (commonly 15 or 30; statutory variants fix this — see conditional fields).

required_fields.name: consequences
required_fields.description: Legal action that will follow non-compliance, limited to what can lawfully be pursued.

required_fields.name: signatory
required_fields.description: Signature of sender/advocate with enrolment details where applicable; retain a signed copy and dispatch proof.

conditional_fields.name: s80_authority
conditional_fields.description: For suits against government/public officer: authority sued. Suit only after the statutory waiting period from service (fill period from sources; do not assume); plaint must state notice was delivered.

conditional_fields.name: s138_cheque_no
conditional_fields.description: For cheque dishonour: cheque number and date.

conditional_fields.name: s138_return_memo_date
conditional_fields.description: For cheque dishonour: bank return-memo date. Notice must be sent within the statutory window running from it (fill from sources; do not assume).

conditional_fields.name: s138_pay_window_days
conditional_fields.description: Drawer payment window after notice receipt (statutory; fill from sources, do not assume).

conditional_fields.name: tenant_premises
conditional_fields.description: For eviction: premises address with lease date, rent and ground (expiry/arrears/breach).

conditional_fields.name: consumer_invoice
conditional_fields.description: For consumer deficiency: invoice number, date, amount and defect description.

boilerplate_structure.fixed_text: Dated notice on the sender's (or advocate's) letterhead with enrolment details where applicable.
The legal basis with the provision cited: {legal_grounds}.
You are called upon to {demand_relief} within {compliance_days} days of receipt of this notice.
Failing which the sender shall initiate {consequences} at your risk as to costs and consequences.
Signed: {signatory}. A copy of this notice has been retained.

notes: Prefer registered post with acknowledgment due for proof of delivery; supplement by email/WhatsApp where delivery can be demonstrated.
Statutory clocks (government-suit waiting period, cheque-notice window) are filled from the statute sources for the matter, never assumed.
